insert into team_application
(user_id, team_id, message, status, applied_at) values (#{userId}, #{teamId}, #{message}, '승인 대기', now())
mapper.select: select * from team_application where user_id = #{userId} and team_id = #{teamId} and status = '승인 대기' order by applied_at desc limit 1

select a.application_id, a.user_id, a.team_id, a.message, a.applied_at, u.nickname, u.profile_image, u.preferred_region1, case t.sport when '축구/풋살' then u.soccer_skill when '농구' then u.basketball_skill when '테니스' then u.tennis_skill when '배드민턴' then u.badminton_skill end as skill from team_application a join user u on u.user_id = a.user_id join team t on t.team_id = a.team_id where a.team_id = #{teamId} and a.status = '승인 대기' order by a.applied_at
